description:
It's those nerves seen in Buttville - second half. You can also choose one of 8 color options. Check the screenshots below.

Since it uses layer 3 as background, it's recommended to use an alternative status bar like Minimalist Status Bar, SMB3 Status Bar or even sprites status bar, so the layer 3 can be used freely.
